verdict.line: You lose extended trades levels 1-6 to Tentacles and W (Harsh Lesson) healing, and win only if you dodge E (Test of Spirit) and snowball off short, dash-in-dash-out trades.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's passive Tentacles spawn on nearby walls and swing at anything close, so every trade near terrain is 2v1 even though it looks 1v1. Riven's E (Valor, cooldown 10/9/8/7/6s) is her only tool to step in, hit, and step back out before a Tentacle or W (Harsh Lesson, cooldown 4s) connects again. This head-to-head sits at 45.4% over 339 games because most Rivens either stand in Tentacle range too long or get isolated by E (Test of Spirit) and lose the split trade.

theirWindow.when: her E (Test of Spirit) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: She can rip your spirit out at 900 range with a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown and start echoing damage back onto you. If you get hit, disengage immediately — don't trade into the spirit or you take double damage and risk becoming a Vessel that spawns Tentacles on you.

yourWindow.when: her E (Test of Spirit) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your only safe trading window. Use Q (Broken Wings, cooldown 13s, range 275) into E (Valor, cooldown 10/9/8/7/6s, range 250) to hit her once and immediately step back out of both her W (Harsh Lesson, range 400) and any nearby Tentacle range before resetting.

playing.title: Never trade near walls
playing.detail: Illaoi's passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that swing at you for free damage and heal her. Fight in open lane space where no Tentacle can reach.

playing.title: Bait E (Test of Spirit) before all-in
playing.detail: Getting hit by her E (900 range, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) means you take echoed damage on top of normal damage. Track it every fight — only commit to extended trades when it's down.

playing.title: Use E (Valor) to punish her W dash
playing.detail: Her W (Harsh Lesson) is a 4-second-cooldown leap to you at 400 range. Since it's so spammable, don't try to out-trade it directly — use your own E (Valor) to step out of range right after she commits.

playing.title: Short trades only, then reset
playing.detail: Land Q (Broken Wings) into one E (Valor) step, then leave. Standing still to auto-attack past that window lets Tentacles and W (Harsh Lesson) stack up on you.

playing.title: Hold R (Blade of the Exile) for post-6 skirmishes
playing.detail: Wind Slash's ranged burst punishes her for over-extending after a W (Harsh Lesson) leap, since she has no gap-closer back to safety once she's committed.

playing.title: Buy Executioner's Calling on sight of heavy sustain
playing.detail: If she's out-healing your trades through Tentacle procs, grievous wounds turns your short trade windows into actual kill windows.

playing.title: Don't fight for lane freeze
playing.detail: OP.GG rates this lane defensive with an Illaoi solo-kill edge — play for wave management and scaling items (Eclipse into Death's Dance) rather than forcing early skirmishes you're statistically behind in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and winrates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the tell, power curve, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read based on the ability mechanics.
